title: 自动生成列表视图仍把注入的 owner_id 当裸 id 首列(#2702 只覆盖了详情,没覆盖 auto-list 列)
body:
## Problem

On an object's **auto-generated default list view** (the "所有记录" tabular view when the object declares no explicit list view), the injected system **`owner_id` appears as a leading, raw-id column** — the exact anti-pattern #2702 set out to remove.

Repro (showcase, v16): open **Invoices** (`showcase_invoice` — it declares no `.view.ts`, so the list is auto-generated). Columns render as:

`#` · **`Owner id`** (raw `1rLx7YrFprCg9I1iVkM48HwxEZ06aUtz`, *identical on every row*) · 发票号 · 客户 · 联系人 · **负责人** (`ada@example.com` …) · 操作

So the list shows **two** owner columns:
- **`Owner id`** — the injected system ownership column, **raw id**, **leading** position, same value on all rows (all seeded by the same principal).
- **负责人** — the business `owner` (`Field.user`), correct **display value**.

Confirmed via API: `owner_id = 1rLx7Yr…` (constant), `organization_id = null`, `owner = ada@example.com`. So the leading id is genuinely `owner_id`, not `organization_id`.

## Why it's a regression/gap
#2702 ("injected `owner_id` stays out of leading auto-derived columns and lands in the detail meta section"):
- **Detail page — correct**: `owner_id` is *not* shown as a field; the meta footer shows "更新人 Dev Admin" (display value, #2689). ✅
- **Auto-generated list columns — not applied**: `owner_id` is still emitted as a leading raw-id column. ❌

So the exclusion covers the detail but not the **auto-list-column generator**. Result: a raw system id as the first data column, redundant with the business owner column — poor first impression on any object without a declared list view.

## Fix
Apply the same injected-system-column exclusion (owner_id / organization_id / created_by / updated_by) to the **auto-generated list column set** that #2702 applied to the detail — keep them out of the default columns (still reachable via column picker if wanted).

Found in the objectstack-ai/framework#3358 v16 sweep (§4 "List polish"). Console-polish umbrella: #2762.
